title: Capacity, Bottlenecks, and Resource Headroom
summary: Use labeled synthetic utilization, demand, reserve, power, and thermal values to identify the limiting resource. State units, assumptions, and uncertainty rather than making production guarantees.
objectives: Reason about physical and virtual infrastructure that supports workloads using synthetic evidence.
Document facts, assumptions, uncertainty, tradeoffs, and safe escalation without claiming professional authority.

vocab.def: Capacity held in reserve for demand, failure, or maintenance.
A constrained resource that limits a system or workload in a scenario.

sections.heading: Prepare
sections.body: This is a simulation-only infrastructure lesson using static scenario data or a disposable local sandbox. Do not use paid cloud resources, real accounts, credentials, secrets, public services, or production systems.

sections.heading: Apply
sections.body: Use labeled synthetic utilization, demand, reserve, power, and thermal values to identify the limiting resource. State units, assumptions, and uncertainty rather than making production guarantees.

sections.heading: Prove
sections.body: Record the evidence source, separate facts from inference, identify a safe authorized next step, name a cross-team handoff when needed, and define validation or recovery evidence.

practice.prompt: What does a telemetry signal establish?
practice.answer: It establishes an observed condition that must be interpreted with context; it does not by itself prove root cause.

quiz.question: Which scope is allowed?
options: Vendor-neutral synthetic infrastructure analysis and safe escalation
Developing or fine-tuning an AI model
quiz.answer: Vendor-neutral synthetic infrastructure analysis and safe escalation

reflectionPrompt: What was observed, what remained uncertain, and what safe authorized action or handoff was appropriate?

careerConnection.text: This is supervised infrastructure education, not cloud engineer, AI engineer, or professional qualification.

criteria: identifies a limiting resource from evidence
uses compute, storage, and network signals
